report:
# FQ-WEYL-FINITE-SCHRODINGER-IRREDUCIBILITY

The source commutant theorem assumes distinct clock eigenvalues and diagonal shift equality; it does not construct a primitive root or prove a representation-classification theorem. This stage constructs all nine actual Weyl matrices at d=3 in Q[w]/(w²+w+1), their Hilbert-Schmidt Gram matrix, rational-matrix Fourier coefficients, reconstruction, and the ordered commutator. Scalar commutant remains the literal supplied-hypothesis kernel statement.

Supported: Exact d=3 Weyl basis reconstruction and commutator controls, plus the generic conditional scalar-commutant theorem and literal cubic-root algebra.

Remaining: Transport the array model to field/matrix semantics and prove representation irreducibility for all admitted odd primes. Primitive-root existence, seed selection and infinite-dimensional results are not derived.
